name: Konbini
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional convenience store, Himawari Mart: a year-end hours-change notice, a first day helping at the register, a guide to payment methods, a trial fried-food corner notice, a new-hire training plan comparison, an essay about learning from a regular customer's change in tone, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to stock shelves, an explainer on why staff guidance is still needed in the self-checkout era, a parcel-pickup service application guide, a column on how cashless payment changed register work, a new rule for late-night shift requests, a column on the meaning of a veteran clerk's skill for sensing a regular customer's change in condition, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elderly-watch network. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
